A '''city''' was located on the planet [[Alderaan]]. The [[city]], along with the rest of the planet, was [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Lost Stars Webcomic" /> in [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The image of the city was drawn identical to the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] city of [[Juranno]], which first appeared in [[Hope (cinematic trailer)|''Hope'']], the second cinematic trailer for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Hope">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/hope-cinematic-trailer|text="Hope"|int=Hope (cinematic trailer)}}</ref>
